name: Xeneny
source: Queen Xeneny is the wife of King Tenemer and ruler of the enigmatic region of Geoyanguk, also referred to as the "Land of the Beginning of Time." Her domain carries the scars of the Second War in Heaven, a cataclysmic conflict that left the land tainted with residues of divine essence, affecting its people and culture. Xeneny exhibits a strong sense of pride and formality despite her aristocratic poise, she is surrounded by a land shaped by lingering horrors, such as strange beasts, skeletons, and grim societal practices, showcasing the harsh and mystical environment she governs alongside her husband.
